evidence.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth2.0 protocol for authentication.
Connect Zoho CRM to any app and perform actions with 5000 API calls/day.
You will receive the client credentials such as Client ID and Client Secret in the Client Secret tab
Deploy four composable MCP servers that give your AI agent secure, scoped access to your Zoho CRM.
Go to Zoho Developer Console and click on GET STARTED

result.notes: Zoho CRM REST API (v8) uses OAuth2 exclusively; self-client and server-based client registration via api-console.zoho.com is free and self-serve, no approval needed. The permanent free CRM plan (3 users) includes 5,000 API calls/day, and paid plans scale credits up. API surface spans dozens of modules (Leads, Deals, Bulk, Notifications, Functions, Blueprint, etc.) — large breadth. Zoho also publishes official MCP servers (Data Insights, Data Operations, Module Customization, Workflow & Process Automation) at mcp.zoho.com, connecting via OAuth. Composio catalog corroborates oauth2-only with 57 wrapped tools (non-official wrapper).
result.one_liner: Zoho CRM is a cloud CRM platform offering a REST API (OAuth2) for managing leads, contacts, deals and workflow automation.
